item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las kye ma 'od mtsho'i gdams pa
item.coloph: de ltar sprang po kho bo yis/ dbyings nyid yum dang mjal nas su/ bka' lung gdams pa thob tshul 'di/ zangs ri 'khyil ba'i mdun drung du/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bzhengs dge ba bsod nams tshogs/ bdag cag gshen grogs 'khor bcas rnams/ kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa phyogs bcur dar rgyas nas/ 'gro don dpag med myur grub ste/ mkha' la nyi shar bkra shis shog/
